description: Implementation of PictureBufferManager for GPU video processing, managing picture buffers, creating video frames, and handling synchronization.

classes.name: PictureBufferManagerImpl
classes.description: Concrete implementation of PictureBufferManager handling GPU buffers, synchronization, and video frame creation.

methods.name: NextID
methods.description: Generates a nonnegative unique picture buffer ID.

methods.name: Initialize
methods.description: Initializes the manager with GPU task runner and command buffer helper.

methods.name: CanReadWithoutStalling
methods.description: Predicts if reading can occur without stalling based on buffer usage.

methods.name: CreatePictureBuffers
methods.description: Creates specified number of picture buffers with associated GPU memory buffers.

methods.name: DismissPictureBuffer
methods.description: Dismisses a specific picture buffer, destroying it if not in use.

methods.name: DismissAllPictureBuffers
methods.description: Dismisses all picture buffers managed by this instance.

methods.name: CreateVideoFrame
methods.description: Creates a VideoFrame from a given Picture, handling GPU memory or native textures.

methods.name: OnVideoFrameDestroyed
methods.description: Callback when a VideoFrame is destroyed, manages synchronization and reuse.

methods.name: OnSyncTokenReleased
methods.description: Handles release of SyncToken, potentially reusing or destroying buffers.

methods.name: DestroyPictureBuffer
methods.description: Destroys a picture buffer, freeing associated textures.
